this_week.title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
this_week.where: SF, NYC, Portland, or remote US/Canada
this_week.why: A genuine Creative Director role building a film-led brand storytelling function, remote-eligible and well-paid, that lines up closely with his big-campaign agency background.
red_flags: If hired as a Canadian employee, pay is in CAD rather than his preferred USD
Heavy emphasis on building a new team/culture, not just creative output
Portfolio must emphasize film-led work specifically, not just integrated campaigns
